title: Smooth admissible approximation in L¹ of a finite measure (density of C_c, cutoff, radial retraction, mollification)
statement: Let ν be a finite measure on ℝ^P, O ⊆ ℝ^P open, K ⊆ O compact and g : ℝ^P → Covector (Euclid P) n ν-a.e. strongly measurable with |g(x)|_E ≤ 1 for all x and g(x) = 0 for all x ∉ K. Then for every ε > 0 there is a smooth compactly supported n-form h (IsTestForm h) with tsupport h ⊆ O, |h(z)|_E ≤ 1 for all z, and ∫⁻ ofReal(|h(x) − g(x)|_E) dν(x) < ofReal(ε).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (O K : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), IsFiniteMeasure ν → IsOpen O → IsCompact K → K ⊆ O → AEStronglyMeasurable g ν → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (g x) ≤ 1) → (∀ x, x ∉ K → g x = 0) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ h : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, IsTestForm h ∧ tsupport h ⊆ O ∧ (∀ z, covectorEuclideanNorm (h z) ≤ 1) ∧ ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (covectorEuclideanNorm (h x - g x)) ∂ν < ENNReal.ofReal ε
